## About

EPM2Mod is a firmware mod for the Olympus PEN E-PM2 (2012), the oldest body in the Atlas. It loads film simulations such as Portra, Ektachrome and Velvia into the art-filter entries, and adds interval shooting up to 240 frames, a level gauge, focus peaking and a lowest shutter speed for ISO Auto.

The E-PM2 is two image-processor generations older than the bodies the Caduceus family patches and has no Color Profiles, so nothing carries over by address. The film simulations are fitted to the camera's own adjustable tone and six-axis colour stages from spektrafilm and Spectral Film LUT renders, and a film file on the card is loaded from a Custom Menu row. The camera keeps them, with their names, after power-off and without the card.

The research is unusually explicit about evidence. Every limit is labelled verified, inferred or unknown, each flash is logged before and after, and each build that moves a hook is run through an emulator boot test first. Five builds failed on the camera, and a normal card update recovered each; a recovery from a boot loop has not been recorded on this body. The project says it was made with heavy use of AI assistance.

### What it's working towards

- Add Effects on film simulations, and a higher movie bit rate without the 29-minute limit.
- The other E-PL6 additions, such as a small AF target and ISO LOW, and a simple on-camera editor.

> **Before you install:** Installing modified firmware is at your own risk. Follow the project's own guide for your exact camera and firmware, and read its safety notes first.

## Features

As the project describes them. Status is the project's own; linked evidence is the Atlas's record of what was reported or observed.

<div class="feature-grid" markdown="1">

<div class="feature-card" markdown="1">

**Film simulations** <span class="pill pill-beta">Beta</span>
{ .feature-head }

Up to 12 of 32 film simulations in the ART entries, loaded from a card file with Load Looks; kept after power-off. For photos and live view; the photo records the film's name.

[PEN E-PM2](../cameras/epm2.md) · since v2026.11.20-rc.1 · [Evidence](../capabilities/epm2-films-look-exif.md)
{ .card-meta }

</div>

<div class="feature-card" markdown="1">

**Interval shooting** <span class="pill pill-beta">Beta</span>
{ .feature-head }

Time Lapse Settings with up to 240 frames.

[PEN E-PM2](../cameras/epm2.md)
{ .card-meta }

</div>

<div class="feature-card" markdown="1">

**Level gauge** <span class="pill pill-beta">Beta</span>
{ .feature-head }

The firmware's own gauge as an LV-Info view, with calibration and the histogram screen's shooting information. Three data edits, no new code.

[PEN E-PM2](../cameras/epm2.md)
{ .card-meta }

</div>

<div class="feature-card" markdown="1">

**Focus peaking** <span class="pill pill-beta">Beta</span>
{ .feature-head }

Turning the focus ring with MF Assist zooms in and outlines sharp edges in white, red, yellow or blue; ported from the E-P5.

[PEN E-PM2](../cameras/epm2.md)
{ .card-meta }

</div>

<div class="feature-card" markdown="1">

**Lowest S/S Setting for ISO Auto** <span class="pill pill-beta">Beta</span>
{ .feature-head }

In P and A, the shutter speed at which ISO Auto starts to rise; a copy of the PEN-F 3.1's logic.

[PEN E-PM2](../cameras/epm2.md)
{ .card-meta }

</div>

<div class="feature-card" markdown="1">

**Debug Log** <span class="pill pill-beta">Beta</span>
{ .feature-head }

A Custom Menu J row, Off by default, that writes EPM2LOG.BIN to the card for developers.

[PEN E-PM2](../cameras/epm2.md)
{ .card-meta }

</div>

</div>

## Releases
